title: LPS unified identity and representative page layouts — replacement design contract

supersedes.note: Values below are PROPOSAL until the token sync lands in theme.json/theme.css (plan task-07). Incumbent semantic tokens are carried forward unchanged.

tokens.usage: Reading and form surfaces; the only approved field for full-color logo artwork
Navigation band and footer band; primary fills
Links and controls on light surfaces; focus outline on light surfaces
Link/control hover and pressed states on light surfaces
Secondary readable text; never essential low-contrast hints
Decorative separators only; never the sole boundary of a control
Focus outline on anchor bands and other dark fills
Status text/icon plus label; never color alone
Status text/icon plus label; never color alone

families.stack: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.owns: Display, h1-h4, navigation, controls, tables, labels, captions, body and long-form reading
families.glyphCheck: 2026-09-18: IBMPlexSans-Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold TTF cmap covers full pt-BR diacritic set, ASCII, and typographic punctuation (895 glyphs; zero missing)
families.delivery: self-hosted woff2, font-display: swap; no remote font loading

families.stack: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "Segoe UI Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.owns: Course codes, record identifiers, code samples, tabular schedule numerals only
families.glyphCheck: 2026-09-18: IBMPlexMono-Regular/SemiBold TTF cmap covers the same set (1049 glyphs; zero missing)
families.delivery: self-hosted woff2, font-display: swap; no remote font loading

scale.use: Mono labels/metadata; never essential instructions alone

rules: Body text is 16-18 CSS px; line height 1.5-1.65; reading measure about 68ch
Sentence case and natural wrapping; no forced breaks; tabular numerals for schedules
IBM Plex Mono is restricted to course codes, identifiers, and code samples
No essential text below the 16px body floor; captions/meta never carry essential instructions alone
If the licensed self-hosted files cannot ship, fall back to the system stack and record the substitution; the decision does not reopen mid-execution

spacing.sectionRhythm: Desktop section spacing 48-80px (--space-12 to --space-20); smaller task-page and mobile gaps

geometry.grid: 12-column on desktop; 8 conceptual columns at 48-64rem; one column below 48rem
rules: Moderate 4px control radii; rectangular images; restrained separators; no universal card wrapper
Breakpoints follow content: one column on small screens; two columns only when both remain readable; full desktop navigation only when all labels fit
Headings adapt within the 32-56px band rather than occupy an entire screen
Short, interruptible interaction feedback only; no entrance animations that hide content
Only transform, opacity, filter, color, and text-decoration may transition; never transition: all; never animate layout properties
prefers-reduced-motion removes movement without removing information
CSS visual order must match document reading and keyboard order
No scroll hijacking, pinned storytelling, autoplay media, marquees, or parallax

source.note: Owner-supplied artwork; bytes preserved verbatim as a source asset. Earlier name lps_logo_vector_transparent.svg referred to this same file.

variants.use: Desktop masthead and any placement at least 240px wide on a light surface
Mobile masthead and constrained placements; keeps the waveform and LPS lettering, drops the long descriptive lettering that cannot stay legible at mobile sizes

derivation.viewBoxDerivation: Union of kept-path bounds x[72,1378.1] y[208.03,467.33] padded 8 units per side
derivation.constraint: No new geometry, no altered paths, no recolor; every kept path d attribute is byte-identical to the source

variants.use: Anchor (navy) surfaces including the footer band, and any context where full-color artwork fails legibility
variants.note: The logo's dark blues measure 1.59-2.25:1 on --color-anchor; artwork is restricted to light surfaces

rules: Full-color artwork appears only on light surfaces (canvas or surface); anchor bands use the text wordmark
Mobile masthead uses the compact variant; the full lockup is never scaled below 240px width
The compact variant is never scaled below 28px height
The logo link carries a meaningful accessible name (e.g. 'LPS — página inicial') without duplicate narration of the embedded title
Clear space around the artwork equals the height of the waveform block on all sides
The waveform gradient stays inside the artwork; no recolor, redraw, effects, or container chrome on the mark

Amendment: the full-color masthead artwork supersedes the repository's text-only-marks rule for this owner-supplied LPS artwork only; UFRJ/COPPE marks remain text-only until their rights owner supplies files and rules
A visible route to contact and accessibility information is preserved
Mobile uses a labelled button and keyboard-operable disclosure, not hover-only navigation
Skip link, breadcrumbs where useful, visible focus, and a stable footer are mandatory

regions: masthead with full-color logo and concise lab introduction
primary links: Conheça a pesquisa; Disciplinas e materiais
one authentic feature image when rights-cleared
research feature with linked areas
differentiated news and upcoming-event content
compact teaching entrance
people/collaboration links
institutional footer

states.empty: Optional sections with no reviewed records are removed; orientation and task entrances remain; no empty-panel grid
states.error: A failed featured record degrades to its text links; the page never shows a broken-image box
states.long-content: Long Portuguese titles wrap by phrase inside the 12-column grid; news lists paginate
states.image-free: The image-free version looks intentional: mission, links, and records carry the page without a placeholder box

regions: reviewed identity, affiliation and role
optional cleared portrait
research interests and scholarly links
projects and publications through shared relationships
Disciplinas e materiais grouped into Em andamento, Próximas ofertas, Ofertas anteriores with explicit term and section

states.empty: No current offering: the Em andamento group collapses and Ofertas anteriores carries the teaching record
states.error: A missing portrait renders the monogram-free text layout; no placeholder silhouette
states.long-content: Twenty prior terms paginate by year; three co-teachers list fully; long names wrap naturally
states.attribution: Past teaching attribution is preserved when login access or affiliation changes

regions: term and section header with teaching team
syllabus snapshot, schedule, venue or approved class link, optional LMS handoff
ordered units with stable anchors
material links near the top on mobile, each with descriptive title, format, size when known, authored language, version/update info, and accessibility alternative when required

states.empty: An offering with no released materials shows the syllabus and schedule with an explicit 'materiais ainda não publicados' notice
states.error: A withdrawn resource shows its withdrawn state; an invalid external link is identified as external without promising availability
states.long-content: One hundred resources group under their units with sticky unit anchors; mixed authored languages are labelled per resource
states.scan-pending: A resource whose scan is pending shows state text and no download control

regions: task list: Meu perfil, Minhas disciplinas, Criar oferta, Adicionar material, Enviar notícia
structured fields with context-aware defaults and locked presentation
previews and revisions

states.empty: A professor with no assigned offerings sees the task list and an explicit assignment notice, not a blank panel
states.error: Validation failure names the field, cause, and repair; access denied is a distinct state from validation failure
states.long-content: Long offering lists paginate; duplicate section attempts surface the uniqueness error
states.lifecycle: Saving, draft saved, in review, scheduled, public, validation failure, scan pending/failed, and access denied are visually distinct states; a saved draft is never styled as a successful publication

applications.spec: Masthead on canvas: full-color artwork at 240-320px rendered width, clear space equal to the waveform height, home-link accessible name; separate primary navigation row below the masthead
Compact artwork at 28-40px rendered height on a light masthead; labelled disclosure button for navigation; the full lockup is never shrunk to fit
News cover images carry no embedded logo; the compact lockup may sit on a light caption mat beside the image when a cover template requires identification
Generated course-document covers place the full artwork top-left on white at minimum 40mm width; course code in IBM Plex Mono; offering term and section below the rule
og:image 1200x630: full artwork centered on --color-canvas with the page title in --color-text; no photography without provenance; no text inside the artwork's clear space
Print keeps the full-color artwork on white at the top of the first page; navigation and interactive controls are stripped; URLs are retained where useful

bans.note: The waveform gradient inside the supplied artwork is the single permitted gradient; it is part of the artwork, not a decorative effect
